name: m365-roadmap-mcp

tools.name: search_roadmap
tools.description:
Search the Microsoft 365 Roadmap for features matching keywords and filters.

Combines keyword search, product filtering, status filtering, cloud instance
filtering, and recency filtering into a single flexible tool. All filter
parameters are optional and can be combined. When no filters are provided,
returns the most recent features.

Use this tool to:
- Browse recent roadmap features (no filters)
- Search for features by keyword (query="Copilot")
- Filter by product (product="Microsoft Teams")
- Find features by status (status="In development", "Rolling out", "Launched")
- Filter by cloud instance (cloud_instance="GCC High", "DoD", "GCC")
- Retrieve a specific feature by ID (feature_id="534606")
- List recently added features (added_within_days=30)
- Filter by release phase (release_phase="General Availability", "Preview")
- Filter by platform (platform="Web", "iOS", "Android")
- Filter by rollout date (rollout_date="2026-03")
- Filter by preview date (preview_date="2026-07")
- List recently modified features (modified_within_days=7)
- Combine any of the above (query="Copilot" + product="Teams" + cloud_instance="GCC")

query.description: Optional keyword to match against title and description (case-insensitive).

product.description:
Optional product tag to filter by (case-insensitive partial match,
e.g. "Teams" matches "Microsoft Teams").

status.description: Optional status filter. Valid values: In development, Rolling out, Launched.

cloud_instance.description:
Optional cloud instance filter (case-insensitive partial match,
e.g. "GCC" matches "GCC", "GCC High" matches "GCC High").

feature_id.description:
Optional roadmap ID to retrieve a single specific feature.
When provided, all other filters are ignored.

added_within_days.description:
Optional number of days to look back for recently added
features (clamped to 1-365). Only features with a created date within
this window are returned.

release_phase.description: Optional release phase filter (case-insensitive partial match).

rollout_date.description:
Optional rollout date filter (partial string match against
generalAvailabilityDate, e.g. "2026-03").

preview_date.description:
Optional preview availability date filter (partial string match
against previewAvailabilityDate, e.g. "2026-07").

modified_within_days.description:
Optional number of days to look back for recently modified
features (clamped to 1-365).

include_facets.description:
When True, includes taxonomy facets (products, statuses,
release_rings, platforms, cloud_instances) with occurrence counts in
the response. Use with limit=0 to get only facets without features.
Facets are computed from matched results after filters are applied.

limit.description:
Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100).
Ignored when feature_id is provided.

instructions:
Query and search the Microsoft 365 Roadmap for upcoming features, release dates, and cloud instance availability.

Use the search_roadmap tool with any combination of filters:
- query: keyword search across title and description
- product: filter by product tag (e.g. 'Teams', 'SharePoint')
- status: filter by status ('In development', 'Rolling out', 'Launched')
- cloud_instance: filter by cloud instance ('GCC', 'GCC High', 'DoD')
- feature_id: retrieve a single feature by its roadmap ID
- added_within_days: show only features added within N days
- release_phase: filter by release ring ('General Availability', 'Preview')
- platform: filter by platform ('Web', 'Desktop', 'iOS', 'Android', 'Mac')
- rollout_date: filter by general availability date (e.g. '2026-03')
- preview_date: filter by preview availability date (e.g. '2026-07')
- modified_within_days: show only features modified within N days
- include_facets: include taxonomy facets with counts (default: False)

Output fields include: products, release_rings, general_availability_date, preview_availability_date, availabilities (per-ring schedule), and more_info_urls.

Tips:
- To get feature details, use feature_id with the roadmap ID.
- To check cloud availability, use cloud_instance with a feature_id or product filter. The cloud_instances field in each result shows all supported instances.
- To list recent additions, use added_within_days (e.g. 30 for last month).
- To filter by release phase or platform, use release_phase or platform filters.
- To search by dates, use rollout_date or preview_date with YYYY-MM format strings.
- To discover available filter values, use include_facets=True (optionally with limit=0).
